         1       every year the Italian-American State

         2       Legislators Conference holds the annual festa

         3       at the Troy Italian-American Center.  This is

         4       the night; this has been the weekend.

         5                  We invite everyone to participate

         6       in this great event -- plenty of food, plenty

         7       of drink.  And we hope everyone comes and has

         8       a good time and meets our honoree for the

         9       year, Tony LoBianco.

        10                  It's a name that should be familiar

        11       to all of us.  Tony LoBianco was born on

        12       October 19, 1936.  I only say that because

        13       that makes him older than me.  For which he

        14       will probably deck me, because he was a Golden

        15       Gloves boxer at one time.  And he looks like

        16       he's in a lot better shape than I am, so I'm

        17       not going to push this too far.

        18                  But he is a great man, he's done a

        19       lot with his career on Broadway, Off Broadway,

        20       TV and films.  His career has run the gamut

        21       from drama to comedy.  He has shown his

        22       talents -- there was only one show that he

        23       appeared in called "Bella Mafia," and I don't

        24       know, I guess it's just fiction, because we

        25       all know there is no such organization.

         1                  But the fact that he is our honoree

         4       it is my pleasure to offer him and ask him to

         5       accept our thanks and gratitude for being here

         6       this day.

         7                  And thank you, Mr. LoBianco, for

         8       being our honoree this year.
